description: This file defines the SubscriptionPlan model class for the OpenCart platform, providing methods to retrieve subscription plan details from the database.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: A model class responsible for interacting with subscription plan data stored in the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription plan record based on its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves multiple subscription plan records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Counts the total number of subscription plan records in the database.
